title: A finite field extension admits a finite algebra model over the power-series polynomial ring
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $A=k[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]][y_1,\ldots,y_m]$ be the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring] in $y_1,\ldots,y_m$ over the formal power series ring $k[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], a domain, with fraction field $K$, and let $M/K$ be a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Then there is a subring $B\subseteq M$ containing $A$ which is a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and whose fraction field is $M$ (every element of $M$ is $b/s$ with $b,s\in B$, $s\neq0$).
